name: Signature Shiny

components.expression: a sly, knowing smile, eyes half-lidded with control.
components.effects: Soft droplets of water hang suspended in the air around her, faint {{MAGIC}} light rippling through them like moonlit tide. A fine prismatic glitter and a gilded, holographic shimmer play across the metal, the fabric and the magic, every glow edged with a rainbow sheen.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Aquaria, visible over the moonlit water beyond the terrace, an Elder Dragon of deep oceanic-blue and deep-teal scales, trailing streams of seawater, wings like rippling sheets of tide-glass edged in polished platinum

notes: SHINY variant of the Signature: same scene and pose in a prismatic, gilded colourway with a holographic glitter sheen. Convention: <slug>-scene-signature-shiny.
